nodes.name: DirectoryExplorerContent.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders an expandable directory listing pane in the editor's main content area, loading folder entries via the filesystem plugin, attaching per-entry git commit metadata, and opening subdirectories in dedicated editor tabs.

nodes.name: loadDirectoryEntries
nodes.summary: Reads a directory's contents via the Tauri filesystem plugin and returns sorted directory/file entries.

nodes.name: loadEntryGitMeta
nodes.summary: Fetches the latest git commit metadata for a single directory entry.

nodes.name: loadEntryGitMetaMap
nodes.summary: Batches git metadata lookups for a capped number of directory entries and returns a path-to-metadata map.

nodes.name: openDirectoryTab

nodes.name: DirectoryExplorerContent

nodes.name: getHostStyleHead
nodes.summary: Collects the host document's stylesheet links and inline style rules into an escaped HTML head fragment for the preview iframe.

nodes.name: buildSrcDoc
nodes.summary: Assembles the full HTML document string (head + body) used as the iframe srcDoc for rendering a cloned DOM snapshot.

nodes.name: RawBody
nodes.summary: Subcomponent that renders the raw captured JSON text for the DOM snapshot preview.

nodes.name: PreviewBody
nodes.summary: Subcomponent that renders the sandboxed iframe preview for a successfully parsed DOM snapshot.

nodes.name: DomComponentPreviewContent
nodes.summary: Top-level component that toggles between raw JSON, rendered preview, and unparsable-content views of a DOM component snapshot.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a tabular preview of database file contents inside the editor's file preview pane.

nodes.name: DbPreviewView
nodes.summary: Memoized component that loads and displays a database file's tables/rows in the file preview pane, handling empty and error states.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Reads a .docx file from disk and converts it to HTML via mammoth for in-editor preview rendering.

nodes.name: DocxPreview
nodes.summary: Component that reads a .docx file and converts it to HTML via mammoth, managing loading and error state during the async conversion.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a collapsible, syntax-aware tree view for JSON file previews with per-node collapsed value previews and clipboard copy support.

nodes.summary: Builds a short collapsed-state preview string (e.g. array length, key count) for a JSON node.

nodes.name: JsonTreeView
nodes.summary: Top-level component that parses JSON content and renders it as an interactive, expandable tree with copy-to-clipboard actions.

nodes.summary: Converts Apple Pages documents to HTML or PDF via a Tauri backend command and renders the result in the file preview pane.

nodes.summary: Reads a PDF file from disk, converts it to a blob URL, and renders it in an embedded viewer within the file preview pane.

nodes.summary: Component that reads a PDF file into a blob URL and renders it in an embedded PDF viewer, cleaning up the object URL on unmount.

nodes.summary: Parses a slide's OOXML string and extracts paragraph text runs grouped by paragraph.

nodes.summary: Loads an image from a data URL and resolves its natural width/height dimensions.

nodes.name: ImageDiffView
nodes.summary: Component that fetches old/new image content for a changed file, loads their metadata, and renders a zoomable before/after comparison view.

nodes.name: index.tsx

nodes.summary: Custom equality comparator used by React.memo to prevent GitDiffContent re-renders when only unstable callback props change.

nodes.name: useGitDiffLoader.ts

nodes.name: preloadSourceControl.ts

nodes.name: preloadSourceControlTabContent
